verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json with HTTP 200 and found an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. The structured API reference pages (e.g., the sonar-post schema) back this up. Missing for 10: first-party docs that advertise or describe the spec download, and evidence that the spec covers all endpoints (Agent, Search, Embeddings, Orchestrator) and stays current.
